The Assistant's guess at step 24 was decisive. It used an unsupported density of about 1.5 g/cm³ and ignored the Trench's peak temperature of roughly 4 °C and the pressure data. It also used liquid density at an assumed pressure, when the correct answer of 55 mL implies a much higher density of about 5.7 g/mL. That figure fits Freon-12 at about 1100 atm and the Trench's peak temperature, since the Orchestrator never obtained the data. The Orchestrator's step 21 instruction, which pushed an approximation, contributed to the error, but the Assistant carried it out by fabricating a rough density and answering 208 mL.
